description: Upscales one of the user's photos to 1K, 2K or 4K, paid from their credits. A photo is offered only the sizes larger than it and at most 4× its size; its prices from get_shoot or list_photos name them. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: upscale
title: Upscale a photo
